title: LegalSearchAnalyticsEvents
description: Source-of-truth catalog for legal-search frontend analytics (telemetry) events. These are client-side product-usage events, distinct from the CloudEvents-aligned pipeline events in this directory. Each event is defined under $defs keyed by its dotted snake_case name. The union type LegalSearchAnalyticsEvent is the discriminated shape the frontend emits via track().

search.executed.title: SearchExecuted
search.executed.description: User ran a search query. Fires on submit, not on every keystroke.

jurisdictions.description: Comma-separated list of jurisdiction codes applied at submit time.

languages.description: Comma-separated list of language codes applied at submit time.

search.refined.title: SearchRefined
search.refined.description: User narrowed an existing search by changing constraints (filters, jurisdictions, etc.) without altering the query text. Distinct from search.executed which fires on a new query submission; here the query is unchanged but the result set was re-fetched.

changedFilterCount.description: Number of constraint dimensions that changed between the previous and new search (jurisdictions, languages, sourceType, officialOnly, refinements).

result.selected.title: ResultSelected
result.selected.description: User opened a search result from the result list.

position.description: Zero-based index within the visible result list.

result.focused_from_list.title: ResultFocusedFromList
result.focused_from_list.description: Detail view actually opened for a result that was focused from the result list (or exact-match header). Distinct from result.selected: this fires only when the focus originated in a list surface, not when the user navigates via a citation link from within an already-open detail panel.

position.description: Zero-based index within the visible result list at the time of focus.

result.pivoted.title: ResultPivoted
result.pivoted.description: User navigated from one result into a related entity (e.g. clicked a citation or cited-by link).

filter.applied.title: FilterApplied
filter.applied.description: User added or toggled on a filter value.

filter.removed.title: FilterRemoved
filter.removed.description: User cleared a filter. Missing value indicates a bulk reset of the filterType group.

filter.reset_all.title: FilterResetAll
filter.reset_all.description: User clicked the 'reset all' affordance on the context bar. Emitted regardless of whether there were active constraints to clear — hadActiveConstraints distinguishes the effective reset from a no-op click that still signals ambient confusion.

activeFilterCount.description: Count of active constraint dimensions that were cleared (0 when the click was a no-op).

hadActiveConstraints.description: Mirrors the hasActiveSearchConstraints check at click time — true when the reset actually changed state.

detail.tab_changed.title: DetailTabChanged
detail.tab_changed.description: User switched tabs in the document detail view.

pin.added.title: PinAdded
pin.added.description: User pinned an item to their workspace.

share.link_copied.title: ShareLinkCopied
share.link_copied.description: User copied a shareable link (document, search, or section).

page.view.title: PageView
page.view.description: First render of a route. Fires once per navigation, not on re-render.
